content.title: Planning to apply?
content.subtitle: If you search for them in the last week, the deadline will pass.

steps.title: Passport
steps.detail: It must be valid and your name must match your other documents. Check the expiry date now.
steps.tip: A spelling mismatch is the most common mistake.

steps.title: Marksheets and transcripts
steps.detail: Scan every semester's copies into one folder. Ask your college early about the official transcript process.

steps.title: Test score reports
steps.detail: IELTS, TOEFL, PTE or GRE, whichever you took. Keep the score report PDF and login details safe.

steps.title: Updated resume
steps.detail: Clean format, simple lines. Put projects, internships and achievements at the top.

steps.title: SOP and LOR drafts
steps.detail: They don't need to be final. A ready draft gives you time to edit.
steps.tip: Name every file like this: Name_Document_University.

content.saveLine: it will help when you apply.

caption:
In application season, most time goes into hunting for documents. Get these 5 ready now 👇

1. Passport
2. Marksheets and transcripts
3. Test score reports
4. Updated resume
5. SOP and LOR drafts

Save this 📌 and send it to a friend who needs it.

👉 app.goeduabroad.com
